name: Alpha Male, Play With My Milf Housemaid
source:
Kim Jae-sun (24 Years Old) is a successful entrepreneur, a handsome and highly renowned figure among businessmen. However, behind his success, he harbors a deep-seated grudge against those who once bullied and made his life miserable.

One day, a housemaid named Han Soo ah finds herself entangled in debt, and she pleads with Kim Jae-sun to help her out, as she has no other option. Unbeknownst to her, her son is one of the individuals who used to bully Kim Jae-sun.

Kim Jae-sun's sinister smile as he plots his revenge.
Or does the revenge turn into an attraction between the man and the woman?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2664280/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
金在善（24岁）是一位成功的企业家，一位英俊潇洒、在商界享有盛誉的人物。然而，在他成功的背后，却对那些曾经欺负过他、让他过得苦不堪言的人怀有深深的怨恨。

有一天，一位名叫韩秀雅的女佣发现自己陷入了债务困境，她恳求金载善帮助她摆脱困境，因为她别无选择。她不知道的是，她的儿子是曾经欺负金载顺的人之一。

金在顺策划复仇时露出阴险的笑容。
还是复仇变成了男女之间的吸引？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2664280/]Steam[/url]]
